4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Due Sunday night: your published bug report (the GitHub Issue you filed on your partner's ROLLER repo) plus your Bug Fix Report on your portfolio site — 1 bug in your own game (filed by a classmate, or found yourself) documented, fixed with Copilot, tested by you as QA, and signed off, with ROLLER v2 pushed. Monday the class votes on its top 3 games, and the winners get played on DONUTS Tuesday.
4th Period.workingNow: Getting your fix signed off by the tester, pushing v2, and writing your changelog.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can get my fix signed off by the tester who found the bug, push v2, and write a changelog that links to the Issue, so anyone can see how feedback improved my game.

Gallery play: scout for Monday's DONUTS vote (5 min)

4th Period.connections: All week you ran a real feedback cycle: test, report, fix, verify. Today you close the loop — the tester who found your bug confirms it's gone and closes the Issue, you ship v2, and your changelog shows exactly what changed and why. Monday the class votes on its top 3 games, and a clip of the winners airs on DONUTS Tuesday.
